findings.label: contract
findings.failure_mode: The access_key hidden input holds the literal placeholder string "YOUR_WEB3FORMS_ACCESS_KEY" instead of a provisioned Web3Forms key; the API rejects every submission it receives with an invalid key, so the contact form silently fails to deliver any message as shipped.
evidence: src/pages/contact.astro:28 — action="https://api.web3forms.com/submit" posts the form directly to the third-party API
src/pages/contact.astro:32 — value="YOUR_WEB3FORMS_ACCESS_KEY" is a placeholder, not a real access key
src/pages/contact.astro:74 — the submit button has no client-side handling of the API's rejection, so the failure is invisible to the visitor

findings.label: duplication
findings.failure_mode: The initials-from-name derivation (split on space, take first letter of each word, keep first two, join) is copy-pasted verbatim from ProductCard.astro into the product detail page instead of being reused. If the initials rule changes, only one of the two copies is likely to be updated, so the product list/home page and the product detail page will silently render different initials for the same product.
evidence: src/pages/products/[id].astro:13-17 — identical const initials = product.name.split(" ").map((w: string) => w[0]).slice(0, 2).join("") re-implemented rather than imported/shared
src/pages/products/[id].astro:26 — {initials} rendered from the page's own copy, independent of ProductCard's copy, so the two can drift out of sync
